{{Quote|My mother always says, drop a wroshyr louse on the Wookiee you like, and he'll be yours forever!|translated=1|[[Jowdrrl]]|<ref name="Chewbacca 1">[[Chewbacca (2000) 1|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Wroshyr lice''' were small parasites found on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that lived on [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] and inflicted [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. They were used to make [[Wroshyr lice syrup/Legends|Wroshyr lice syrup]]. It is said that when a female Wookiee drops a Wroshyr louse on a male Wookiee it is a gesture of affection. The female Wookiee is then supposed to groom the fur of the male hit with the louse as an apology. [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] attempted to drop a louse on [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], however, he was pushed out of the way by another Wookiee right before the louse hit.
